Scene:
一个人对神农说，麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？神农说，这就要看你想不想生病了。以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 麻烦我们可以吃什么植物：麻烦告诉我们……
- 以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃：后来，Time+以后；告诉人们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”；哪些，哪些

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 这就要看你想不想生病了：这就要看是什么植物了，this pattern should give a flexible answer to the question of which plants are edible; the part after 看 needs to be the relevant question, here what kind of plant it is. [rule: zhe_jiu_yao_kan]
Run 2: 这就要看你想不想生病了：这就要看是哪种植物了，this pattern should give the condition that determines the answer to the earlier question. Whether someone wants to get sick does not answer which plants can be eaten; the phrase after 看 is correctly a question form in the revision. [rule: zhe_jiu_yao_kan]
Run 3: 这就要看你想不想生病了：这就要看是哪种植物了，The phrase “这就要看……了” should answer the uncertain point in the preceding question. Here, the question is which plants are edible, so the part after “看” should ask which plant it is. [rule: zhe_jiu_yao_kan]

output.reason: All runs identify that “看你想不想生病” does not answer which plants are edible and replace it with the relevant plant-type condition.
